jobs.description:
Functiebeschrijving

(Note: This job posting is only
open to native level or near-native level Dutch speakers
. If you are not proficient in Dutch, please have a look at our other job postings instead!)

Spreek jij native of near-native Nederlands? Lees dan verder!

Heb jij ervaring met data engineering met een achtergrond in .net/C# en wil je mee bouwen aan ons monitoringplatform voor onze klant? Lees dan verder!

Jouw rol in ons team

Als Data Engineer bij ons Monitoring Platform (PMP) project, ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de datastromen in ons platform. Dit platform verzamelt real-time data van de assets van de beheerder van de Rail Infrastructuur in Nederland, zoals stroomverbruik metingen van wissels en bruggen en data van objecten zoals wisselverwarming en tunnel technische installaties. Je werkt nauw samen met een multidisciplinair team bestaande uit softwareontwikkelaars, technische ontwerpers en projectmanager.

Hoe jij ons team versterkt

We zoeken een veelzijdige en proactieve professional met sterke analytische vaardigheden en een toewijding aan teamwork en resultaten. De ideale kandidaat heeft:

Een afgeronde HBO/ WO opleiding met sterke IT component en/of data-engineering
Kennis van Microsoft Azure
Ervaring met programmeren, bij voorkeur in C#/.Net
Goede communicatievaardigheden, zowel in het Nederlands als in het Engels
Bereidheid om te reizen naar klantenlocaties, CGI kantoren of thuiswerken indien nodig.

Een pre-employment screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure

Waarom CGI

CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancy bedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld.

We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken.

Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook vaak leidt tot betere resultaten. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team!

Werken in kleine zelfsturende teams bestaande uit experts in je vakgebied.

De regie over je eigen carrière met daarbij de ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen.
Je werkt met de nieuwste technologieën.
Een uitstekend salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden
Direct een vast contract
Parttime mogelijkheden
En de mogelijkheid om CGI aandeelhouder te worden

Waar kom je terecht

Je komt te werken in een hele gezellig Unit Rail Infra binnen Vital Civil Infrastructures. Daarin speel je een cruciale rol in de uitdaging om verouderde IT-systemen in de spoorwegsector te vernieuwen. CGI, gevestigd in Rotterdam werkt aan de transformatie van railsystemen die essentieel zijn voor de besturing van het Nederlandse spoorwegnet. Deze systemen zijn verantwoordelijk voor de aansturing van seinen, wissels, en treinposities, en omvatten simulatiesystemen met 3D visualisaties voor het vooraf testen van praktijkveranderingen bij machinisten en treindienstleiders.

Sluit je aan bij ons team van experts en solliciteer direct!

Meer informatie over de inhoud van de vacature? Neem contact op met Director Consulting Services Jeroen Silfhout via jeroen.silfhout@cgi.com.

Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem contact op met Recruitment business partner Natrah Pula via 06 11218723 of via Natrah.pula@cgi.com.

Wij werken niet samen met externe recruitment-partijen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van onze vacatures wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld!

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Criteria

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT-dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien.

Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede-eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf.

Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega's en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise.

Ontdek bij ons de mogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zet de volgende stap in je carrière. Hier staat jouw succes centraal!

jobs.description:
Job Description

Why join us

Get ready to Own innovation as a Hyperautomation Developer at Nutreco, an SHV company. As global leaders in animal nutrition and aquafeed, our shared purpose of Feeding the Future drives us to build smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable digital capabilities across the business. Join us and help shape Nutreco’s digital transformation as you Own your ideas, Own your creativity, and Own the future of automation.

A cornerstone of Nutreco’s strategy is hyperautomation, leveraging low‑code technologies, AI, and intelligent automation to reinvent the way we work. You will play a key role in accelerating this transformation by designing high‑impact digital solutions and empowering teams around the world with tools that enhance how we collaborate, decide, and innovate.

What You’ll Do

In this exciting and hands‑on role, you will design, develop, and scale advanced digital solutions that streamline operations, boost efficiency, and enable smarter decision‑making across Nutreco’s global organisation. You will:

Design and develop digital applications using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI), Copilot, and related frameworks to drive automation and process optimisation.
Identify automation opportunities globally, partnering with Business Units to uncover digitisation needs and build intelligent, scalable solutions that drive efficiency and innovation.
Build and nurture a global network of citizen developers, coaching colleagues across locations and departments to automate processes and contribute to Nutreco’s automation culture.
Lead digital innovation projects, collaborating with Scrum teams, IT leadership, and Business Units to accelerate transformation and ensure delivery of high‑quality solutions.
Leverage AI, agentic AI, RPA, and low/no‑code tools to enhance business processes and optimise decision‑making across the organisation.
Validate value creation, ensuring implemented solutions are tracked, measured and financially validated with Finance.
Act as Scrum Master, facilitating Agile practices, leading ceremonies, and driving continuous improvement within the team.
Support the setup and growth of Nutreco’s AI Center of Excellence, contributing to architecture, governance, and scaling of AI‑powered automation initiatives.

Who We’re Looking For

You’re someone who is responsible, curious, and ready to Own this role. You combine hands‑on technical capability with the ability to influence and connect communities across a global matrix organisation. You’ll also need:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Innovation Management, or related field
5+ years’ experience designing and deploying automation solutions (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, AI/Copilot, RPA)
Experience in change management (ADKAR) and stakeholder engagement across business and technical teams
Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non‑technical audiences
Passion for technology, innovation, and continuous learning, with strong adaptability to emerging trends
Ability to coach, connect, and build communities (citizen developers, ambassadors, federated teams)
A collaborative mindset and eagerness to understand Nutreco’s global business context

What You’ll Receive

As part of Nutreco, you’ll join a global community committed to innovation, sustainability, and digital enablement. You will work in a highly collaborative environment that gives you the freedom to experiment, learn, and drive meaningful impact.

A full‑time position in a dynamic, international organisation
Competitive salary, strong pension scheme, and 30 vacation days
Opportunities for professional growth within Nutreco and the broader SHV Group
Flexibility to work from home multiple days per week
Access to an inspiring global Digital organisation focused on AI, automation, and transformation.

How And Why To Find Out More

If you’re ready to play a central role in scaling digital innovation across Nutreco—and to own your innovation, we’d love to hear from you. We aim to respond to all applicants within five (5) business days and the typical hiring process lasts 4–6 weeks. We appreciate your interest in helping shape the future of digital transformation at Nutreco.

jobs.description:
About the role: What's in the Box

As a Staff Engineer in our Supply Chain Management organization, you will be responsible for defining, securing, and implementing technical solutions for business problems. You will play a critical role as our systems scale to handle a jump from 1.2 million to over 2.4 million produced boxes per week due to recent software product consolidation. You will look after speeding up development, decision-making, and problem-solving. You will work with our neighboring teams to ensure that our efforts aim to achieve a clearer architecture and boundaries between tech teams to support autonomy. You will communicate directly with our business stakeholders and multiple tech teams supporting local markets. You will report to the Director of Engineering in the Production tribe. This role does not include people management responsibilities.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

Assume technical leadership within a tribe and own the most challenging tech decisions, including architecture, design, development, deployment, and operational excellence.
Support the teams in the architectural design and help to maintain architectural integrity in the scope of the tribe and beyond.
Spend a significant portion of your time orchestrating code generation—guiding AI coding agents, rigorously reviewing their implementations, and refining logic based on organization needs.
Solve software problems that have visible risks, roadblocks, and constraints. You will navigate an environment that is approximately 70% greenfield development and 30% legacy systems, managing dependencies, data quality, compliance, and architectural transformations.
Mentor more junior engineers by fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

Ideally, 10+ years of engineering experience, including 2+ years in a staff/principal level capacity and technical leadership.
Strong capability in working with different stakeholders and experience addressing physical world problems with software solutions.
Full-Stack & Agentic Engineering: Deep problem-solving skills and full-stack proficiency (e.g., C#, Python, Golang, and modern frontend technologies). You bring hands-on experience leveraging AI coding agents (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code) in production, moving beyond basic prompting to master context engineering, workflow decomposition, and the implementation of strict guardrails for reliable agent outputs.
Experience with data engineering fundamentals is highly desirable, including expertise in data modeling, governance, quality assurance, and proficiency in data processing and storage systems.
Expertise in designing and implementing modular systems, including proficiency in synchronous/asynchronous communication.
A team player attitude and a passion for helping others grow through peer-to-peer mentoring, knowledge-sharing sessions, and advocating for best engineering practices, such as CI/CD, TDD, BDD, DDD, and Design Patterns.
An agile mindset with the ability to advocate for cross-functional collaboration.

Interacting with front-end developers, designers, product managers and our teams around the world is very much part of our day-to-day, so communication skills are vital. We are looking for strong problem-solvers who can apply their engineering skills to a wide range of platforms and environments, while also acting as an ambassador to coach team members and stakeholders.

What we offer: The Toppings

The Role

Location:

WTW is seeking a technically credible engineering leader to mature and scale engineering capability across ICT. This is not a traditional Director of Engineering role: there are no direct reports. Instead, it is a strategic, deeply technical role focused on improving engineering consistency, software delivery maturity and effectiveness across five autonomous engineering stacks. They should be capable of being hands-on, for the purposes of reinforcing their strategic direction in the space of DevEx and being credible and authentic in the face of technical professionals.

The stacks have been given autonomy to improve delivery velocity. The next phase retains that autonomy while introducing the right level of shared practice, tooling consistency and technical governance. Success depends on technical depth and the ability to build consensus — influencing engineering decisions through credibility and evidence rather than formal authority, and being willing to roll up sleeves and get into technical and code-level problems when it helps move things forward.

Their scope is to ensure that, across 400+ technical professionals dispersed into teams aligned to Products, they are able to reinforce modern best practices — especially in an agentic world — and bring the teams along a journey to a more consistent, modern, AI-native software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering practice & SDLC maturity: raise the quality and consistency of software design, development, testing and delivery; improve route-to-live, release management, quality gates and CI/CD; reduce manual effort where automation adds value.
Technical governance & consensus: provide constructive, hands-on challenge to engineering and architecture decisions; build alignment across stacks while respecting differing product, commercial and lifecycle needs; support pragmatic technical-debt strategies.
Tooling & developer experience: assess and improve developer experience; standardise and consolidate tooling where it creates clear value (including the move to GitHub as a strategic platform).
AI adoption across the SDLC: drive practical adoption of AI-enabled engineering across development, testing, review, documentation and support, aligned to governance and measurable outcomes.
Engineering metrics & insight: improve visibility of delivery health using frameworks such as DORA and the LinearB pilot; define WTW-specific “lighthouse metrics” that reflect real effectiveness, not activity.
Shared engineering capability: reduce duplication across stacks; promote reusable components, patterns and common engineering services where appropriate.

Technology Environment

The environment uses, or is moving towards: C#, .NET / .NET Core, Microsoft Azure, GitHub (an increasingly strategic platform), Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and automation, and engineering analytics tooling including the LinearB pilot. Greater consistency in engineering practices and stronger technical alignment across stacks.
Improved SDLC maturity, better CI/CD and reduced manual effort, through the adoption of AI, automation and other mechanisms

Clearer engineering metrics and improved visibility of delivery health.

A healthy balance between stack autonomy and organisational consistency.

Strong technical depth: able to hold their own with Stack Engineering Leaders and dive into architecture, code and delivery detail when it adds value.
A natural consensus-builder: challenges decisions constructively, aligns strong personalities, and creates momentum without unnecessary friction.

Our staff come from diverse backgrounds, based across multiple geographies, and building models that utilise highly varied data sources – everything from kilobytes of academic papers to terabytes of hourly scenario projections for 50+ years. They need rapid access to data, analytics outputs, and highly scalable data processing infrastructure. Our scale and model complexity has reached a point that to continue to achieve our business vision, we are building a dedicated global Data and Processing Platform team.

Come and join us to be part of the energy transition, the defining challenge of our lifetimes, where your technical skills and experience can have real impact.

What you will be doing

We are looking for a Senior Platform Software Engineer to join as a core member of the Data and Processing Platform team, taking on a key role alongside the Engineering Lead to build the foundations and shared capabilities that support Baringa’s continued growth and evolution.

You will help shape the design, implementation and ongoing support of a greenfield Data and Processing Platform and its supporting software products

You will help drive engineering best practices, ensuring that quality, reliability and observability are built into our products from inception.
You will design and implement robust CI/CD automation flows, continually evolving our processes to improve the engineering experience for ourselves and the teams we support.
You will take an active role in all stages of the team’s agile development approach, from refinement through to delivery, supporting the iterative improvement of our team processes.

Your Skills And Experience

You are passionate about building the ‘right’ solution to problems, with a desire to understand the problems at their core and ‘why’ a solution is fit for purpose.
You will have practical experience as a senior engineer in high-performing engineering teams, collaborating closely with colleagues and taking pride in what you create.
You are strong at solving complex problems and can flexibly consider different technologies/engineering approaches to achieve this.
You have advanced working knowledge of a general programming language (e.g. Python, Java, C#, Typescript etc.) and understand both domain modelling and application programming.
You have working knowledge of data management technologies (SQL, NoSQL, Databricks etc.)
You have working knowledge of modern software engineering tools (Git, CI/CD pipelines), cloud technologies (e.g. AWS, Azure) and Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, Pulumi)
You have worked across the technology stack with experience of established frameworks (e.g. React/Angular/Vue/Blazor frontends and/or FastAPI/Spring Boot/.NET backends)
You have experience building and supporting different architectural approaches and are confident in justifying your technology and architectural choices.
You are passionate about communicating complex concepts succinctly to both technical and non-technical audiences to reach a common understanding.
You have experience working with agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum/Kanban), with an understanding of the key principles that underpin their effective use.

We’ve seen research that says some candidates will not apply to a role if they don’t meet every requirement, but please do not let this put you off. If you think you are a good overall match please do get in touch – we look carefully at all applications, and you may well be our ideal candidate.

Putting People First.

Benefits

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act.
